integrity: Exact integral chain computations in the included standard-library script; published underlying nonequivariant theorem is cited and is not claimed as a new result.
scientific_limitations: One finite graph-metric scale and its order-two antipodal quotient; no general cube-dimension formula or independent audit. Reuses the published nonequivariant nine-sphere homotopy theorem; an equivalent unindexed geometric quotient theorem remains possible.
title: The antipodal quotient of the four-cube scale-two Vietoris–Rips complex
